author: CommonLayer base image maintainers
tooling: Written by hand; applied by scripts/scan.sh through trivy --vex and grype --vex

vulnerability.name: CVE-2025-60876
vulnerability.description: BusyBox wget request-target injection (CR/LF and control bytes in the request line).

statements.impact_statement: The image's BusyBox is rebuilt from Alpine's busybox 1.37.0-r31 source and patches with the wget applet (and every other network client) compiled out; see image/busybox/config-deny.txt in https://github.com/envaro/commonlayer-base. The build fails if a wget applet is present, and scripts/test.sh checks the applet list of the built image. busybox-binsh only provides the /bin/sh link to the same binary.
